# Parse note 1556 content for Tarantino-directed movies
note1556 = contents[1556]
content = note1556.get('content','')
print('content_length', len(content))
print(content[:300])

# Simple parsing: assume format: '# Movie Recommendations' then movie titles on lines, followed by ' - director: NAME' etc.
lines = [ln.rstrip() for ln in content.splitlines()]

movies=[]
current_title=None
current_director=None
current_genres=[]
for ln in lines:
    if not ln.strip():
        continue
    if ln.startswith('#'):
        continue
    # title lines without '-' and ':'
    if ln.startswith(' - '):
        # property lines
        if 'director:' in ln:
            current_director = ln.split('director:')[1].strip()
        if 'genre:' in ln:
            genres_str = ln.split('genre:')[1].strip()
            current_genres = [g.strip() for g in genres_str.split(',')]
    else:
        # new title line
        # commit previous when we hit new title? We'll commit when director set and next title occurs.
        # but easiest: if title line and current_title already exists, commit previous.
        if current_title is not None and current_director is not None:
